confidence_notes: Holistic general-knowledge estimate; no live price pages or listings were checked. Cafe, beer and restaurant anchors are moderately reliable, while hostel and hotel rates are less certain because July event demand can move room prices sharply. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor because direct knowledge of them is weaker. USD values assume roughly 1.33 USD per GBP from general knowledge, not a live rate. The RBA rate came from an rba.gov.au search summary; the page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other mid-sized UK regional cities such as Bristol, Birmingham and Manchester, positioned below London; food and drink levels follow typical UK pub and cafe pricing.
